title: Kyiv — City Above the River
subtitle: Seven scenes through water, gold, stone, streets, and a city that keeps becoming.

chapters.title: Before the Streets
chapters.text: Kyiv begins with geography: a wide river, steep green hills, islands, mist, and paths climbing from the water. Long before domes defined the skyline, the Dnipro gave the city its horizon and its direction.
chapters.image_alt: A real photograph of the Dnipro River and Kyiv, finished as a monochrome editorial retouch

chapters.title: The Golden Gate
chapters.text: In the age of Yaroslav the Wise, Kyiv announced itself through walls, gates, and sacred buildings. The Golden Gate was both defence and ceremony: an entrance designed to turn arrival into an event.
chapters.image_alt: A real photograph of the Golden Gate reconstruction in Kyiv, finished as a monochrome editorial retouch

chapters.title: Sophia’s Gold
chapters.text: Inside Saint Sophia, stone dissolves into image. Mosaics, frescoes, candlelight, and centuries of repair make the cathedral less a frozen monument than a surface continuously remembered.
chapters.image_alt: A real photograph of Saint Sophia Cathedral in Kyiv, finished as a monochrome editorial retouch

chapters.title: Down to Podil
chapters.text: The descent bends between façades, courtyards, studios, and views toward Podil. Here Kyiv feels theatrical and domestic at once: a city discovered not from a plan, but one doorway and one slope at a time.
chapters.image_alt: A real photograph of Andriivskyi Descent in Kyiv, finished as a monochrome editorial retouch

chapters.title: A House That Dreams
chapters.text: Horodecki’s house turns the respectable city into a strange bestiary. Rhinoceroses, frogs, elephants, and sea creatures climb across concrete, proving that Kyiv’s architectural memory also has room for wit and dreams.
chapters.image_alt: A real photograph of the House with Chimaeras in Kyiv, finished as a monochrome editorial retouch

chapters.title: Under the Hills
chapters.text: Kyiv’s metro stitches together riverbanks and high ground. Long escalators descend through geology; trains emerge onto bridges; everyday movement becomes a hidden architecture beneath the historic city.
chapters.image_alt: A real photograph of a Kyiv metro escalator, finished as a monochrome editorial retouch

chapters.title: A City That Returns
chapters.text: Kyiv is not a finished monument. It is morning coffee after a difficult night, voices returning to the square, chestnuts flowering again, and the Dnipro still carrying light past the hills.
chapters.image_alt: A real photograph of Independence Square in Kyiv, finished as a monochrome editorial retouch
